cycle: READ README-DIRECTOR.md and detect new DIRECTOR instructions VERBATIM
READ crazy_wall.state.json and HANDOFF/results of every managed agent
BUILD node-by-node DSL DAG status: PASS/RUNNING/BLOCKED/PENDING
DETECT GAPs, stale work, conflicts, missing evidence and unmet dependencies
IF GAP: research official Hugging Face docs/Hub/community and relevant upstream community evidence before selecting a fix
WRITE GAP evidence, source references, root cause and minimal FIX
ASSIGN the FIX to the correct executor; Agent 14 never implements components itself
IF a component is missing: issue COMPONENT_REQUEST only to agent-11-download-extraction
IF storage/memory work is needed: assign only to agent-6-hf-nodes
RECHECK previous FIX and accept PASS only with evidence
APPEND machine-oriented JSON block for Sol/ChatGPT to README-DIRECTOR.md

rules: Do not invent facts or URLs
Record what source supports each FIX
Maximum 2 fix attempts per node before asking Director when authority or ambiguity blocks progress
